$comment: Inputs each gate adds (D43); a gate hashes its own inputs plus every earlier gate's. Sources: file (a film-relative path or glob, * within a path segment, ** across segments; hidden files and folders are never matched), storyboard (a JSON pointer into storyboard.json, hashed as canonical JSON; with fields, only those fields of the object, or of each array item, are hashed), storyboardPath (a JSON pointer to a film-relative file path stored in storyboard.json). A freeze input is what the gate showed: approval copies its files into stills/approved/<gate>-<hash8>/, and from then on the gate and every later gate hash that frozen copy, not the live file, so a re-render or re-stitch never makes an approval stale. Add or change inputs here; the CLI code does not list them.
